title: Bump golang.org/x/net from 0.30.0 to 0.36.0
body:
Bumps [golang.org/x/net](https://github.com/golang/net) from 0.30.0 to 0.36.0.
Commits
  • 85d1d54 go.mod: update golang.org/x dependencies
  • cde1dda proxy, http/httpproxy: do not mismatch IPv6 zone ids against hosts
  • fe7f039 publicsuffix: spruce up code gen and speed up PublicSuffix
  • 459513d internal/http3: move more common stream processing to genericConn
  • aad0180 http2: fix flakiness from t.Log when GOOS=js
  • b73e574 http2: don't log expected errors from writing invalid trailers
  • 5f45c77 internal/http3: make read-data tests usable for server handlers
  • 43c2540 http2, internal/httpcommon: reject userinfo in :authority
  • 1d78a08 http2, internal/httpcommon: factor out server header logic for h2/h3
  • 0d7dc54 quic: add Conn.ConnectionState
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view

title: Cgroup support
body:
Third and last main PR, support for Cgroup limits and namespace isolation. 

Minor updates to the design doc
- reducing the preset memory limit from 500MB to 50MB to make testing easier.
- use /sys/block instead of /proc/partitions to lookup block devices for io.max cgroup.

If time allows, more PRs will come with more features. (pivot root/image support, stdin/tty, window manager, etc)

title: Job manager implementation
body:
This is the second out of three main PRs. It covers the Job Management and is the first version that is fully usable. The third main PR will handle the resource limits / process isolation.

- Minor precision on the design doc around stop job
- Broadcaster
- All endpoints fully implemented, including logs from the beginning and stop causing a different status
- New target `make build/debug` to compile binaries with the race detector and symbol, and dump goroutines/memory info periodically.
- Tests for GetJobStatus with various scenario, happy/sad path.

title: Add CLI, authn, authz
body:
This is the first PR out of 3 main PRs. It covers the CLI, authentication and authorization.

The second part will be about the Job Management and the third will be about resource limits / job isolation.

- Add client CLI using `urfave/cli` (Added mention of this in the design document).
- Add mTLS support for client and server
- Add authorization policies
- Mock job manager, handling start job to allow testing of authorization
- Implement the StartJob api endpoint (based on a mocked job manager).
- Add tests for:
  - Happy path: Start Job, Stop Job.
  - Sad Unauthorized path: Start Job as Alice, attempt to Stop job as Bob
  - Sad Unauthenticated path: Attempt to Start job with client unknown to the server.
